title: Going Beyond XAI: A Systematic Survey for Explanation-Guided Learning
reasoning: The paper includes a significant focus on AI Ethics, specifically the FaccT (Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency) framework. It discusses using Explanation-Guided Learning (EGL) to infuse 'human virtues' into models and evaluates techniques based on their ability to mitigate social biases (such as race and gender) and improve model fairness.
